description.value:
As a Demon Hunter, you can choose a Fighting Style feat, the Druidic Warrior option of the Player's Handbook, or the following Void Warrior option.

Void Warrior. You learn two Warlock cantrips of your choice; @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplChillTouch]{Chill Touch} and @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.spells.Item.txZXlAW3p4AuqhIF]{Mind Sliver} are recommended. They count as Ranger spells for you, and Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a Ranger level, you can replace one of them with another Warlock cantrip.

Foundry Note

With Void Warrior, add the two Warlock cantrips to your sheet with Wisdom as their spellcasting ability.
